route_definitions.user_local_private_route: Private/user/project/host-specific corrections stay in .xiigen or another approved user root and can become candidate refs only after DPO authoring approval, source/license/privacy/redaction/provenance review, and later lifecycle binding.
route_definitions.common_route: Common route is closed unless the material is universal orchestration/skill semantics from MIT, Apache-2.0, or approved equivalent permissive/open source with source/license review and material-quality PASS.
route_definitions.quarantine_route: Unknown license/source, raw external output used as training target, private leakage, stack-specific common proposal, reviewer prose as target, or source-disjoint overlap goes to quarantine/evidence-only until repaired.
